meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 在 NanoClaw 中启用 Codex 作为代理后端。装上后,你可以为某个群组选用 OpenAI Codex 来执行规划、工具调用、MCP 工具、服务端历史记录和会话恢复,替代 Claude。
howto.when: 当你要求安装 Codex 支持,或为某个群组设置 provider 为 codex 时。

say.text: 帮我安装 Codex 支持。
say.note: 将按步骤复制文件、注册并重建容器。

say.text: 把群组 my-group 的 provider 切换为 codex。
say.note: 执行后该群组改用 Codex 代理。

say.text: 把新群组的默认代理设为 codex。
say.note: 需操作者确认后才会执行。

howto.what_en: Enables Codex as an agent provider in NanoClaw. After install, you can choose OpenAI Codex as the backend for a group (instead of Claude) to handle planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, and session resume.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to install Codex support, or when you set a group's provider to codex.

say_en.note: It will copy files, register, and rebuild the container.

say_en.text: Switch group my-group's provider to codex.
say_en.note: The group will use Codex after this.

say_en.text: Set the default provider for new groups to codex.
say_en.note: Needs operator confirmation before it runs.
